Tests for AI-assisted real-time collaboration demand end-to-end coverage of multi-client sync, offline resilience, model versioning, guardrails, and auditability. This ensures the system remains correct, observable, and reproducible during complex deployments.

- End-to-end test matrix with offline scenarios
- CRDT-based synchronization and conflict resolution
- Feature flags and model version rollout

  })

## Why This Is Asked
Tests for offline-first apps cover real-world reliability with intermittent connectivity. A beginner-friendly task focuses on practical steps rather than abstract concepts.

## Key Concepts
- Offline simulation and network throttling
- Data seeding across devices
- Conflict resolution (last-writer-wins)
- Idempotent, duplicate-free sync
- Timing constraints for visible convergence

## Code Example
